lba_qa.q: A girl buys a table for 1000 rupees and sells it for 1200 rupees. Find her profit and profit percentage.
lba_qa.a:
Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price
= 1200 - 1000 = 200 rupees.

Profit percent = (profit / cost price) x 100
= (200 / 1000) x 100
= 20 percent.

So profit is 200 rupees, that is 20 percent. ✅

lba_qa.q: A shirt marked at 800 rupees is sold at a 25 percent discount. Find the selling price.
lba_qa.a:
Discount = 25 percent of 800
= (25/100) x 800 = 200 rupees.

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount
= 800 - 200
= 600 rupees.

So the selling price is 600 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: Find the simple interest on 5000 rupees at 8 percent per year for 2 years.
lba_qa.a:
Simple Interest = (P x R x T) / 100
= (5000 x 8 x 2) / 100
= 80000 / 100
= 800 rupees.

So the simple interest is 800 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: A trader buys goods for 600 rupees and sells them for 540 rupees. Find his loss percentage.
lba_qa.a:
Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price
= 600 - 540 = 60 rupees.

Loss percent = (loss / cost price) x 100
= (60 / 600) x 100
= 10 percent.

So the loss is 10 percent. ✅

lba_qa.q: Find the compound interest on 2000 rupees for 2 years at 10 percent per year, compounded yearly.
lba_qa.a:
Amount = P x (1 + R/100)^T
= 2000 x (1 + 10/100)^2
= 2000 x (11/10) x (11/10)
= 2000 x 121/100
= 2420 rupees.

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal
= 2420 - 2000
= 420 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: A bill of 1200 rupees includes 20 percent GST. Find the GST amount.
lba_qa.a:
GST = 20 percent of 1200
= (20/100) x 1200
= 240 rupees.

So the GST amount is 240 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: In a class of 50 students, 30 are girls. What percentage of the class are girls?
lba_qa.a:
Percentage of girls = (30 / 50) x 100
= 60 percent.

So 60 percent of the class are girls. ✅

lba_qa.q: A man buys a cycle for 2400 rupees and sells it at a profit of 15 percent. Find the selling price.
lba_qa.a:
Profit = 15 percent of 2400
= (15/100) x 2400 = 360 rupees.

Selling Price = Cost Price + Profit
= 2400 + 360
= 2760 rupees.

So the selling price is 2760 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: The price of rice rose from 40 rupees to 50 rupees per kg. Find the percentage increase.
lba_qa.a:
Increase = 50 - 40 = 10 rupees.

Percentage increase = (increase / original) x 100
= (10 / 40) x 100
= 25 percent.

So the price increased by 25 percent. ✅

lba_qa.q: A sum of money amounts to 6600 rupees in 2 years at simple interest of 10 percent per year. Find the principal.
lba_qa.a:
Let principal = P.
Simple Interest for 2 years = (P x 10 x 2)/100 = 20P/100 = P/5.

Amount = P + Interest
6600 = P + P/5
6600 = 6P/5
P = 6600 x 5 / 6
P = 5500 rupees.

So the principal is 5500 rupees. ✅
